messages:
Lina: Hi team — auditor asked for proof of KMS key rotation and delegated access after last RBAC change. They want the rotation event, who initiated it, and the service account mapping to justify control A.9.2.
Tom: Got it. Which key(s) are they asking about? primary app-encryption key or the CI/CD signing key?
Gina (Auditor): primary app-encryption key (projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/app-encrypt). We also need the history for last 12 months, rotation schedule, and any emergency-unseal events.
Lina: We rotated app-encrypt on 2025-11-03 per process, and did an emergency wrap on 2026-01-12 for INC-842. Need to show CloudTrail/Cloud Audit logs + KMS key metadata export.
Tom: For quick artifacts I can export: 1) IAM policy change for that key 2) Cloud Audit log entries for CryptoKey versions 3) rotation metadata. Command I use: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy app-encrypt --keyring=main --location=global --project=redwood-prod`
Tom: And for rotation events: `gcloud logging read \"resource.type=crypto_key AND protoPayload.methodName=\\\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.UpdateCryptoKey\\\"\" --project=redwood-prod --limit=100`
sec-bot: [automated snapshot] KMS rotation event detected 2026-01-12T03:24:10Z user:tom@redwood.ai protoPayload.methodName=UpdateCryptoKey details=\"rotationPeriod changed -> 30d\" :information_source:
Irene: For the auditor, also include `keyVersion` creation/deprecation entries: `protoPayload.methodName=\\\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.CreateCryptoKeyVersion\\\"` and `DestroyCryptoKeyVersion` if present.
Gina (Auditor): We also need evidence linking RBAC change PR to the IAM policy change (who approved the PR) and the JIRA ticket. A single zip with log snippets and screenshots is fine.
Lina: PR is #infra/2483, reviewed by Jamal. JIRA is SEC-842 (incident ticket). I'll bundle PR link + approver screenshot.
Tom: Note: the service account mapping changed during canary: `svc-app-encrypt@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` was granted `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on 2025-11-03. I'll include `gcloud projects get-iam-policy` output and the audit log entries that show `member` and `principalEmail`.
Gina (Auditor): Good. Also confirm retention: how long do you keep admin/crypto logs? We need at least 12 months for SOC 2.
Lina: We retain Cloud Audit logs for 24 months in the audit log bucket (audits-prod), with 30-day hot retention in Splunk for quick search.
Tom: I'll export the log slice to a signed S3 URL and generate a manifest.json with checksums. Example manifest fields: file, start_ts, end_ts, sha256.
Irene: Small ask: scrub any unrelated PII from logs before handing off. Use the grep filter: `--filter=\"protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\\\"*redwood.ai\\\"\"` to reduce scope.
Gina (Auditor): Fine. Last ask: include evidence of KMS key custody process (who has emergency access and how it's logged). A screenshot of the emergency-access runbook and the on-call rotation is enough.
Lina: We have the runbook at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-emergency and the on-call rota in OpsGenie (screenshot attached in bundle).
Tom: Action: I'll produce the logs + IAM diff + key metadata export by EOD PST and upload to the auditor bucket. Will include a short README describing each artifact.
sec-bot: [incident link] INC-842 — emergency key wrap initiated by tom@redwood.ai — artifact id: a8f3-20260112 — uploaded to auditor-bucket/INC-842/a8f3.zip
Gina (Auditor): Thanks — once I have the zip I'll validate the timestamps and the signer fields. If anything missing I'll ping here. :thumbsup:
Lina: Thanks all. I'll update the control mapping doc to point to the artifact URLs and note the RBAC change window.
Tom: FYI — during vuln triage for INC-842 the findings were: temporary service account key leakage (rotated), no data exfil detected. I'll include the triage notes in the package.
Irene: Also adding the Splunk query strings used to extract the logs to the README so auditor can reproduce if needed.
Gina (Auditor): Perfect. Closing loop after I validate the bundle.
Lina: assigning follow-ups: Tom -> export/upload; Irene -> scrub & add queries; Lina -> control mapping update.
Tom: On it.
